The prototype did something today. Something that would exclude me and it from society forever if people found out. No one can know. I worked too long on this. I’m so close. I can feel it! I won’t write down the details, since I don’t want to incriminate myself even further. Project shouldn’t be in jeopardy since I got rid of the evidence. My hands are shaking while writing this, addressing once a living being as “evidence” is frightening to me. What have I become while in pursuit of my goal? Seeing something like that being done by your own creation feels different than seeing it in the labor camp, but I can’t stop now. I never begged God for anything, but please do not take away my life’s work from me. I helped your guy a lot! Does that mean nothing to you?! I had to shut the prototype down. I didn’t get the details why it did it, but when I looked at its face I saw no remorse whatsoever. For now I will check the code. There must be some bug that caused it, it must be! My concept is perfect, this should never have happened!

Everything seems fine for the moment. New version I installed yesterday seems to be working well so far. In the end I couldn’t pinpoint the exact reason why the incident happened, but I changed some things (devlog_736) and put in place some additional precautions. Prototype’s operating power is lower than before by 6%, but that’s a small price to pay. I will optimize it later after I make sure that there are no more bugs in its moral judgment system.

I was wrong. I was very wrong. My changes in the code did not bring intended results. I don’t know how it’s possible, but the prototype changed files to which it shouldn’t have access. I need to shut it off before it realizes my intentions.
